arxiv-2111-10639.title: Implicit Acoustic Echo Cancellation for Keyword Spotting and Device-Directed Speech Detection
arxiv-2111-10639.creator: Samuele Cornell, Thomas Balestri, Thibaud Sénéchal
arxiv-2111-10639.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Samuele Cornell, Thomas Balestri, Thibaud Sénéchal. In many speech-enabled human-machine interactions, user speech can overlap with the device playback audio. In these instances, the performance of tasks such as keyword-spotting (KWS) and device-directed speech detection (DDD) can degrade significantly. To address this problem, we propose an implicit acoustic echo cancellation (iAEC) framework where a neural network is trained to exploit the additional information from a reference microphone channel to learn to ignore the interfering signal and improve detection performance.

arxiv-2211-00611.title: MedSegDiff: Medical Image Segmentation with Diffusion Probabilistic Model
arxiv-2211-00611.creator: Junde Wu, Rao Fu, Huihui Fang, Yu Zhang, Yehui Yang, Haoyi Xiong, Huiying Liu, Yanwu Xu (✉)
arxiv-2211-00611.description: Abstract Diffusion probabilistic model (DPM) recently becomes one of the hottest topic in computer vision. Its image generation application such as Imagen, Latent Diffusion Models and Stable Diffusion have shown impressive generation capabilities, which aroused extensive discussion in the community. Many recent studies also found it is useful in many other vision tasks, like image deblurring, super-resolution and anomaly detection.

arxiv-2309-06048.title: Determination of lower order perturbations of a polyharmonic operator in two dimensions
arxiv-2309-06048.creator: Rajat Bansal, Venkateswaran P. Krishnan, Rahul Raju Pattar
arxiv-2309-06048.description: Abstract . We study an inverse boundary value problem for a polyharmonic operator in two dimensions. We show that the Cauchy data uniquely determine all the anisotropic perturbations of orders at most m − 1 m-1 and several perturbations of orders m m to 2 ​ m − 2 2m-2 under some restriction.

arxiv-2311-11128.title: Evolutionary game selection creates cooperative environments
arxiv-2311-11128.creator: Onkar Sadekar, Andrea Civilini, Jesús Gómez-Gardeñes, Vito Latora, Federico Battiston
arxiv-2311-11128.description: Abstract The emergence of collective cooperation in competitive environments is a well-known phenomenon in biology, economics, and social systems. While most evolutionary game models focus on the evolution of strategies for a fixed game, how strategic decisions co-evolve with the environment has so far mostly been overlooked.

arxiv-2405-15397.title: Comparative Analysis of Four Prominent Ant Colony Optimization Variants: Ant System, Rank-Based Ant System, Max-Min Ant System, and Ant Colony System
arxiv-2405-15397.creator: Ahmed Mohamed Abdelmoaty*
arxiv-2405-15397.description: Abstract This research conducts a comparative analysis of four Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) variants - Ant System (AS), Rank-Based Ant System (ASRank), Max-Min Ant System (MMAS), and Ant Colony System (ACS) - for solving the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). Our findings demonstrate that algorithm performance is significantly influenced by problem scale and instance type.

arxiv-2406-03689.title: Evaluating the World Model Implicit in a Generative Model
arxiv-2406-03689.creator: Keyon Vafa, Justin Y. Chen, Ashesh Rambachan, Jon Kleinberg, Sendhil Mullainathan
arxiv-2406-03689.description: Abstract Recent work suggests that large language models may implicitly learn world models. How should we assess this possibility? We formalize this question for the case where the underlying reality is governed by a deterministic finite automaton. This includes problems as diverse as simple logical reasoning, geographic navigation, game-playing, and chemistry.

arxiv-2409-10390.title: Can vortex quantum droplets be realized experimentally?
arxiv-2409-10390.creator: Guilong Li 1, Zibin Zhao 1, Bin Liu 1,2, Yongyao Li 1,2, Yaroslav V. Kartashov 3, Boris A. Malomed 4,5
arxiv-2409-10390.description: Abstract The current state of research on vortices carried by quantum droplets (QDs) has predicted their existence, in the stable form, in two- and three-dimensional free-space binary Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) and dipolar BECs. These theoretical results suggest that QDs may be excellent carriers of self-trapped vortex states.

arxiv-2502-07811.title: CrossVideoMAE: Self-Supervised Image-Video Representation Learning with Masked Autoencoders
arxiv-2502-07811.creator: Shihab Aaqil Ahamed, Malitha Gunawardhana, Liel David, Michael Sidorov, Daniel Harari, Muhammad Haris Khan
arxiv-2502-07811.description: Abstract Current video-based Masked Autoencoders (MAEs) primarily focus on learning effective spatiotemporal representations from a visual perspective, which may lead the model to prioritize general spatial-temporal patterns but often overlook nuanced semantic attributes like specific interactions or sequences that define actions - such as action-specific features that align more closely with human cognition for space-time correspondence.

arxiv-2505-15244.title: Reliable Vertical Federated Learning in 5G Core Network Architecture
arxiv-2505-15244.creator: Mohamad Mestoukirdi, Mourad Khanfouci
arxiv-2505-15244.description: Abstract This work proposes a new algorithm to mitigate model generalization loss in Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) operating under client reliability constraints within 5G Core Networks (CNs). Recently studied and endorsed by 3GPP, VFL enables collaborative and load-balanced model training and inference across the CN.

pmc-10598828.creator: Hinari Sakai, Tsz-Ming Yung, Tomoki Mure, Naoki Kurono, Syuji Fujii, Yoshinobu Nakamura, Teruaki Hayakawa, Ming-Chia Li, Tomoyasu Hirai
pmc-10598828.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) is typically achieved with a chiral luminophore. However, using a helical nanosized fused quartz cell consisting of chiral silica, we could control the wavelength and helical sense of the CPL of an achiral luminophore. Chiral silica with a helical nanostructure was prepared by calcining a mixture of polyhedral oligomeric silsesquioxane (POSS)-functionalized isotactic poly(methacrylate) (it-PMAPOSS) and a small amount of chiral dopant.

pmc-11349568.title: The emerging roles of LINC00511 in breast cancer development and therapy
pmc-11349568.creator: Lifeng Zhao, Sangita Biswas, Yepeng Li, Suren Rao Sooranna
pmc-11349568.description: Breast cancer (BC) is associated with malignant tumors in women worldwide with persistently high incidence and mortality rates. The traditional therapies including surgery, chemotherapy, radiotherapy and targeted therapy have certain therapeutic effects on BC patients, but acquired drug resistance can lead to tumor recurrence and metastasis. This remains a clinical challenge that is difficult to solve during treatment.

pmc-11459599.title: Revolutionizing Neonatal Care: A Comprehensive Review of Intact Cord Resuscitation in Newborns
pmc-11459599.creator: Sai Bhavani Manchineni, Revat J Meshram
pmc-11459599.description: Neonatal resuscitation is a critical procedure aimed at ensuring the successful transition of newborns from intrauterine to extrauterine life. Traditionally, this involves immediate clamping and cutting of the umbilical cord, but recent advances have introduced intact cord resuscitation (ICR) as an alternative approach. This review aims to comprehensively analyze ICR, exploring its evolution, scientific basis, and clinical evidence.

pmc-12660301.description: IntroductionChronic pain is a major global health problem that significantly affects quality of life and increases the risk of cardiovascular diseases.MethodsUsing the Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 data, this study analyzed temporal trends in chronic pain across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2021.

pmc-12749471.title: Design parallel and sequential quantum algorithms via spectral element method on distributed quantum architectures
pmc-12749471.creator: Amir Hossein Salehi Shayegan
pmc-12749471.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this work, we present a solution to the critical limitation of qubit capacity in near-term quantum hardware by giving a hybrid framework that integrates the spectral element method (SEM) with distributed quantum computing. Using domain decomposition techniques, the additive and multiplicative Schwarz methods, the global problem is divided into smaller subproblems that each require significantly fewer qubits, making them suitable for current quantum devices. The HHL algorithm is applied locally to these subproblems, enabling quantum speedups without exceeding hardware constraints.

pmc-13071146.title: Bladder Stone Secondary to Migration of an Intrauterine Device: A Case Report
pmc-13071146.creator: Mario Arturo Martin‐Dorantes, Erick Antonio Rochel‐Perez, Michel Alfredo Bastarrachea‐Solis, Juan Pablo Flores‐Tapia, Ashley Yael Sotelo‐Casas, Nina Méndez‐Domínguez
pmc-13071146.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Intravesical migration of intrauterine devices (IUDs) is an uncommon complication that may lead to recurrent urinary tract infections, lower urinary tract symptoms, and bladder stone formation. Diagnosis requires high clinical suspicion and confirmation through imaging and cystoscopy. We present the case of a 33‐year‐old hypertensive woman with a history of two cesarean deliveries for preeclampsia who underwent IUD placement in 2016. She subsequently developed recurrent urinary tract infections. In 2024, hysteroscopic removal was attempted unsuccessfully.

pmc-13250493.title: Cognitive Load Across Interaction Formats in Digital Attention Assessment for Children: Within-Subject Neuroimaging and Behavioral Comparison Study
pmc-13250493.creator: Harim Jeong, Yong Jeon Cheong, Jihyeong Ro, Jihyun Cha, Jongkwan Choi, Minyoung Jung
pmc-13250493.description: BackgroundDigital health technologies increasingly use tablet-based cognitive assessments for children, yet interaction design choices can substantially influence cognitive load and measurement validity. Although cognitive load has been extensively studied in educational settings, its impact on patient-facing digital assessment tools for pediatric populations remains underexplored.

pmc-13642432.title: Reflections on the neural processing of echoes for distance information in echolocating bats
pmc-13642432.creator: Alan D Grinnell
pmc-13642432.description: Multiple neural specializations in echolocating bats enable target distance determination by measurement of the delay between many frequencies in the emitted FM signal and the same frequencies in returning echoes. In the neotropical lesser bulldog bat, Noctilio albiventris, a short constant frequency (CF) component preceding the FM sweep in emitted sounds is critical to the measurement of pulse-echo delay.
